healthRule: A UK1 pipeline notice is kept when the buyer name contains NHS, Integrated Care Board, Health Board, Health and Social Care, Department of Health, UK Health Security Agency or Supply Chain Coordination, or any CPV code on the notice begins 33 (medical equipment, pharmaceuticals and personal care products) or 851 (health services). A bare 'Trust' is not a match.
scopeNote: Procurement Act 2023 pipeline notices (UK1) are published only by contracting authorities spending over 100 million pounds a year, for contracts over 2 million pounds they expect to advertise in the next 18 months. Smaller trusts do not publish them, so an absence here is not an absence of plans.
valueNote: A null value means the notice states none, or states a placeholder of 1 pound or less.
